title: Playing Vladimir Horowitz's piano at Boston Symphony Hall
summary: At the band's Symphony Hall concert he discovers the piano he is warming up on was Horowitz's that afternoon.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: But we played there, and then we did a concert in Boston at Symphony Hall. Somebody booked us for a concert after we'd finished the engagement at this club. We did this concert in Boston Symphony Hall. It was an evening concert; I think it stated at 8 o'clock. So when we went in... I always tried to

get there early and run over the piano or whatever. So we got in, and I was playing over this piano. And one of the stagehands from the conservatory said, "Do you know whose piano that is you're playing?" I said "No." I thought it was a piano that belonged to the hall." He said, "That piano also belonged to Vladimir Horowitz. He had a concert here this afternoon." Of course, I had heard of him and... I had never heard him play in person then, but I knew who he was, and I was very honored and proud to be playing that instrument, which seemed to me like one of the easiest instruments I've ever played. I was just sort of amazed at the action on the instrument and everything.
